description:
Hailey Atelier is founded on a lifelong fascination with the beauty of the world around us and the desire to capture it through painting.

As a painter, I am inspired by how light, colour, and atmosphere intersects. My work explores the relationship between lived experience and the qualities of paint itself, from texture and layering, to colour and contrast. I am particularly interested in capturing the essence of a scene rather than its every detail. 

For me, painting is as much about discovery as it is about the finished piece. Each painting is an opportunity for me to observe the details and qualities that make our world unique, which gives me a new lens of experiencing the fleeting moments of everyday life.

I hope you find the same sense of wonder in my work that I do in creating it. 

Thank you,
Hailey
